intro: WH3RE isn’t a booking system. Here’s what actually works for this place:

notes.tabit: Tabit also handles deliveries: only a table booking will count as a visit.
notes.noPlatform: This place isn’t on Ontopo or Tabit. I only show you what actually exists.

text.ontopo: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking on Ontopo.
text.tabit: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking on Tabit.
text.site: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking on the restaurant’s website.
text.tel: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking by phone.
text.wa: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking on WhatsApp.
text.maps: You’re leaving WH3RE to finish your booking on Google Maps.

reply.yes: Perfect. I’m keeping {place} in your memory as booked, not visited yet. I’ll ask you tomorrow how it was.
reply.notYet: No worries. I’ll keep the table open in your conversation. Tell me if you’d like another time or another place.
reply.otherPlace: Got it. I won’t count this booking. Want to tell me where you’re going instead? It’ll make your memory richer.

feedback.recommend: Would you recommend it to someone?
feedback.notVisited: No problem, I won’t count this visit.
feedback.thanks: Thanks. It’s saved in your memory. It’ll sharpen my next answers.
feedback.thanksRecommended: Thanks. It’s saved in your memory as a place you recommend. It’ll sharpen my next answers.
feedback.share: Share this feedback with my private circle
feedback.shareNote: Off by default. Never posted publicly.
